what_it_does: Solving large sparse linear systems is pervasive in science/engineering; Krylov solvers can be slow for ill-conditioned matrices; MCMC-based preconditioners effective but parameter selection is manual/grid-search (costly) AI-driven framework using graph neural network surrogate to predict preconditioning speed; Bayesian acquisition function selects parameter sets minimizing iterations; applied to ill-conditioned linear systems.
